profile.headline: Software Engineer at Printforia, Inc
profile.summary:
I’m a full-stack web developer who loves solving problems, adapting quickly and learning as I go. 

Most recently I was working at Brandless as a member of the logistics team. While there I built a custom warehouse management system to facilitate in-house order fulfillment and developed other software, including on our main e-commerce platform, pertaining to order flow and management.

My first full-time programming job was at Walker & Company Inc. While there I worked on a small, agile team maintaining one brand’s website while launching a new one. Thanks to the success of these brands the company was acquired by Procter & Gamble.

Since leaving Walker & Company, I have been doing contract work focused on WordPress development. I am seeking additional contract work or potentially a new full-time or part-time role on a remote team.

positions.title: Comedian and Business Manager
positions.description:
- Built comedy website to connect with fans and calendar for upcoming shows using JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3.
- Created and managed weekly comedy show with local acts, attracting over 160 audience members per gig, becoming Yelp’s #1 for nightlife in SF for 2 years.
- Toured nationally with various comedy groups, performing for over 3,000 audience members across 11 cities.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
- Collaborated with insurance experts to develop and implement plan recommendation algorithms utilizing calculus (limits + integrals) written in Ruby, improving speed and level of detail of the user experience (UX).
- Wrote Unit and Integration tests using RSpec following TDD principles  greatly increasing coverage of codebase.
- Constructed RESTful routes on a Ruby on Rails server through building a recommendations controller that matched scored insurance plans against user entered preferences. 
- Ran Rails migrations on PostgreSQL DB to update tables with new columns, increasing accuracy of  algorithms.
- Followed agile development methodologies which involved weekly standups, Trello for task management, and Git with Bitbucket for version control, ensure quality of API in conjunction with the front-end engineers.
- Deployed to staging and production server using Heroku CLI, properly configuring Rails and Redis environment.

positions.title: Staff Analyst
positions.description:
- Maintained and edited website for self-represented litigants with 240,000+ visitors per month.
- Go-to person for all computer- and web-related issues in the division of 100+ employees.
- Designed and deployed surveys and analyzed data from responses.
- Edited videos and maintained YouTube channel.

volunteerExperiences.role: Dining Room Volunteer at St. Anthony's Foundation
volunteerExperiences.description: Assisted with various functions in the dining room at St. Anthony's, serving meals to homeless and low-income residents of the Tenderloin neighborhood of San Francisco.

projects.title: Battleship
projects.description:
Browser version of the classic board game that allows two users to duel each other on the high seas online.

- Engineered Node server with node-static to handle battleship game logic, and Socket.IO for real-time gameplay.
- Recreated the Battleship experience by designing the UI/UX using JavaScript, jQuery, HTML5 and CSS3.

projects.title: Snake
projects.description:
- Developed and implemented game logic, and player keyboard input commands using vanilla JavaScript.
- Utilized ReactJS to build game board views, snake and apples following modular design for separation of logic.
- Designed the UI/UX, allowing for different game board sizes using using CSS3 and HTML5.
